dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Here's how your whisps are performing.

emptyState.title: No whisps sent yet
emptyState.description: Start sharing meaningful videos with the people you care about.

ghostBoosts.title: Ghost Boosts
ghostBoosts.description: Ghost Boost queues a whisp for boosted, wider-reach delivery instead of a direct message — it doesn't guarantee it reaches one specific person the way Whisper Link does.

suggestions.title: Suggestions Library
suggestions.description: Browse a curated library of videos and whisper one to someone in your circle who could use it.

header.title: Send a Whisp
header.subtitle: Share a video anonymously with someone you care about.

url.heading: Paste a video link
url.description: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Vimeo — any public video URL.

upload.heading: Upload a video
upload.description: Under {{duration}}, MP4/WebM/MOV. Kept short so it loads fast for the recipient.
upload.tapToChoose: Tap to choose a video from your device

camera.heading: Use your camera
camera.description: Take a photo or record a video (under {{duration}}) right here — no need to leave the app.

library.heading: Your Media Library
library.description: Reuse a clip you've already uploaded.
library.empty: Nothing here yet — upload a video to add one.

concierge.heading: Not sure what to send?
concierge.description: Describe the situation and we'll suggest a video from our Suggestions Library and draft an anonymous note to go with it.
concierge.placeholder: e.g. I want to tell my brother I'm proud of him but don't know how
concierge.resultsHeading: A few videos that might fit:
concierge.noMatch: No strong match in our library for this one — but here's a note draft below. Pick your own video from another tab and it'll carry over.
concierge.useNoteOnly: Use this note, I'll pick a video

step2.noPreviewDescription: We can't generate a preview for {{platform}} links, but you can still send it — just double-check the link works for you.
step2.trimHint: Jump straight to the good part, e.g. 1:24, and stop there instead of implying they watch the whole thing.
step2.moodSubtitle: Optional — sets the emotional tone for the recipient.

step3.heading: Add an anonymous note
step3.subtitle: Optional — max 200 characters. The recipient won't know it's you.
step3.placeholder: Write something kind, honest, or brave...

step4.heading: How should it be delivered?

whisperLink.description: Send straight to them — direct, instant, guaranteed delivery

groupWhisper.title: Group Whisper
groupWhisper.description: Send the same anonymous whisp to a saved group of your contacts at once
groupWhisper.price: Uses Whisper Link credits, 1 per member
groupWhisper.noGroupsCreate: You don't have any groups yet — create one

ghostBoost.description: Matched to strangers who opted in to hear about topics like this one — anonymous both ways. Reach isn't guaranteed; it depends on how many people are subscribed right now.

step4.scheduleDescription: Send now, or pick a future date and time

step5.heading: Who should receive it?
step5.description: Enter an email or a phone number (in international format, e.g. +1 555 123 4567). Add commas if more than one.
step5.invalidRecipients: Not a valid email or phone number: {{list}}
step5.groupNoticeBold: This will be saved as a Whisper Group ({{count}} people)
step5.groupNoticeRest: so you can reuse it later. Everyone gets their own private whisp — they won't see each other, and each one uses a Whisper Link from your plan.
step5.preferWhatsApp: Send to phone numbers on WhatsApp instead of SMS
step5.smsDisclosure: By sending to a phone number, you're texting them on your own behalf. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. See our

step6.heading: Ready to send?
step6.matchedSubscribers: Matched subscribers interested in this topic

sent.title_one: Your whisp is on its way
sent.title_other: Your whisps are on their way
sent.description_one: It's been sent. We'll let you know when it's seen.
sent.description_other: Sent to {{count}} people. We'll let you know as each one is seen.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this whisp?
deleteDialog.descriptionWithReplies_one: This whisp has a reply from the recipient. Deleting it removes it — and that reply — from your whisps. This can't be undone from your side.
deleteDialog.descriptionWithReplies_other: This whisp has {{count}} replies from the recipient. Deleting it removes it — and that reply thread — from your whisps. This can't be undone from your side.
deleteDialog.descriptionNoReplies: This removes the whisp from your whisps. This can't be undone from your side.

whispDetail.appreciationYes: They said this was something they needed to hear

outOfReplies.description: They can't reply again unless you add more replies, or they create a free account. You can still send follow-ups.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this whisp?
deleteDialog.description: This hides it from your own list — the recipient's link, and their view of it, keeps working as already delivered. This can't be undone from your side.
